purpose: analysis-only physical characterization; Plant/log values never enter controller or detector inputs

resource_policy.guard: wait_for_capacity before each episode and every 250 cycles outside controller timing

contact_model_statement: Force-displacement is reported as sampled nonlinear data; no linear contact assumption is made.

quasi_static_dynamic.classification: posthoc lower-quartile absolute box-bottom speed is retained only as a descriptive low-speed subset; contact loss/bounce prevents a quasi-static stiffness inference

late_contact_dynamics.interpretation: unilateral damped contact/bounce; a transient 0.5mg crossing is not sustained G4 support or a stiffness sample

derived_boundary_measurements.definition: observed displacement from first F>1 N sample to first F>0.5mg sample divided by measured time remaining from first contact to release
derived_boundary_measurements.r1_0p01m_s_comparison: measured descriptive comparison only; not a selected bound and not a linear-contact extrapolation

transient_support_warning: The first 0.5mg crossing is impact/transient evidence only; sustained pre-release support is reported separately.

r1_reference_timing.source: frozen R1 Controller constants and _reference equations; descriptive, not Plant truth

publication_note: Raw process IDs omitted. Every case, numeric metric, eigenvalue, load/RAM summary and timing outlier is retained. Evidence hashes elsewhere may name the original work record; published-byte hashes are in artifacts/SHA256SUMS.
